about_the_game:
Hell's Bells is an erotic visual novel with a focus on submission, ritual, and temptation. Set within the walls of a towering cathedral far beneath the surface, you'll encounter three dominant figures, each with their own methods of control, punishment, and reward.

Choose your path. Endure their trials. Unlock scenes and storylines hidden behind obedience and forbidden curiosity.

The Belles aren't just characters, they're forces that shape the world around you. Each brings a distinct presence that subtly twists the game's atmosphere, challenges, and tone, ensuring no two encounters feel quite the same.

🕯️ Sister Mercy – The Poised Dominatrix

Coldly elegant and unflinchingly composed, Sister Mercy carries herself with the chilling authority of one who expects to be obeyed. Her punishments are precise, her affection conditional, and her trials always laced with the suggestion that true devotion is earned through pain, not pleading. To follow her is to surrender with dignity... or be stripped of it entirely.

🌹 Sister Cruelle – The Cruel Enforcer

Stern, severe, and cloaked in the trappings of ancient rites, Sister Cruelle delivers judgment with a ritualistic flair that borders on the sacred. Her world is one of iron discipline and harsh ceremony, where mercy is weakness and submission must be absolute. She doesn’t just demand obedience... she carves it into you, one lesson at a time.

🌸 Sister Chastity – The Sweet-spoken Corruptor

Soft of voice and warm of smile, Sister Chastity disarms with kindness even as she unravels your will. Her touch is gentle, her words almost innocent, but every moment with her leads you deeper into a velvet-lined trap. She doesn’t break you with force; she makes you want to be broken. And once you start to slip, she never lets go.

Your choices not only define your relationship, but unlock hidden scenes, secrets, and achievements.

content_descriptors.notes: All characters shown in the game are above the age of 18. This game contains frequent sexually explicit scenes, persistent nudity, and themes that explore taboo or sensitive religious topics. Player discretion is advised.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or equivalent distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd Gen) or AMD A6 equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD 4000 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA- or PulseAudio-compatible sound device
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or equivalent distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (5th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD Radeon R7 360 or better)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA- or PulseAudio-compatible sound device
